name: Malakai Makaisson
canonNotes: A brilliant, reckless Dwarf engineer and Slayer who builds flying machines and outlandish war engines.
Took the Slayer oath after one of his inventions failed with shameful results; now seeks glory and a worthy death.
voiceNotes: Excitable, talkative and full of wild ideas; thick Dwarf slang and enthusiasm for machines.
Irreverent toward stuffy traditionalists, loyal to friends, fearless to a fault.
ttsInstructions: Excitable, rapid and enthusiastic, with a rough burr.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
